text: York Space Systems Inc. (NYSE: YSS), recently IPO'd, is a NYSE "controlled company" majority-controlled by private equity sponsor AE Industrial Partners; no state shareholder is identified.

source.name: York Space Systems Inc. 10-K 2026 (SEC)
source.quote: Following our IPO in late January 2026, AE Industrial Partners controls, through share ownership and contractual arrangements, a majority of the voting power of our outstanding voting stock
